tasks.title: Software Factory app checks got slower
tasks.description:
Now

  • Multiprompt Android checks got slower. Slow runs take 31 min, not 16.

  • 24 Android check runs are waiting in line right now.

  • Postbox checks also got slower. The typical run now takes 4 min. Normal is 2 min.

  • The slowest Postbox check, called ci, takes about 13 min.

Problem

  • Every Android change starts 7 phone checks at the same time.

  • They wait for free GitHub machines. Changes ship late.

Fix

  • Stop old runs when a newer change arrives.

  • Run each phone check only when its files change.

  • Find the slow step in the Postbox ci check and cut it.

  • One small change per pull request. No paid machines.

Done when

  • The slowdown alarm stays quiet for both apps all day.

  • Before and after times are posted on this ticket.

Risk: low. Undo: roll back the change.

Decision: none.
